title: Zesty Lemon & Garlic Roasted Chicken
instructions: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels to ensure a crispy skin.
Mince the garlic and mix with olive oil, lemon zest, and chopped rosemary.
Rub the mixture under the skin and over the chicken breasts.
Sear in a hot oven-proof skillet for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Transfer skillet to a 200°C oven and roast for 12-15 minutes until internal temp hits 74°C.
Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing to keep the juices inside.

title: Classic Italian Bruschetta
instructions: Diced the tomatoes and remove the seeds to prevent the bread from getting soggy.
Tear the basil leaves by hand to prevent bruising (keeps them bright green).
Mix tomatoes, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil in a bowl. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Toast the bread until golden and rub the raw garlic clove directly onto the warm surface.
Top with the tomato mixture and a final drizzle of balsamic glaze.

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter until they release their water and turn deep brown.
In a separate pan, soften the onion and add the rice, toasting it for 2 minutes until translucent at the edges.
Add stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly. Wait for the liquid to be absorbed before adding more.
This constant stirring releases the rice starch, creating the signature creamy texture.
When the rice is al dente, stir in the mushrooms, parmesan, and a final knob of butter.
Serve immediately while it's still 'all'onda' (wavy).

title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Season the salmon generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place skin-side down in a medium-hot pan with oil. Press down with a spatula for 30 seconds to prevent curling.
Cook for 4 minutes until the skin is crispy and the flesh is cooked halfway up.
Flip and add the asparagus to the pan with a knob of butter.
Baste the salmon with the foaming butter for the final 2 minutes.
Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice over the fish and greens.
